dailyMistakes.name: Daily mistake digest
dailyMistakes.prompt: Summarize the mistakes I added today: group them by topic, count how many fall under each topic, highlight my 3 weakest areas by error frequency, and give one concrete, actionable review tip for each weak area (e.g. redo a question type or revisit a concept). Finish with a one-paragraph recap of how today went overall.

weeklyReport.name: Weekly study report
weeklyReport.prompt: Write my weekly study report: 1) total study time this week and how it splits across subjects; 2) flashcards reviewed and how retention changed; 3) mistake trends, calling out topics that improved or got worse versus last week; 4) based on this data, give 3 focused recommendations for next week. Use a concise, sectioned format.

morningReview.name: Morning review reminder
morningReview.prompt: Good morning! You have flashcards due and material waiting for review today. Spend 15 minutes clearing today's review queue while your mind is fresh, then move on to new material.

examSprint.name: Exam sprint plan
examSprint.description: Sprint checklist on exam day (pick the date)
examSprint.prompt: Today is a critical review day. Using my mistake log and weak areas, build today's sprint checklist: 1) pick the 10 mistakes most worth redoing and explain why; 2) list 3 core concepts I must lock in, each with a quick self-test; 3) lay out a morning/afternoon/evening schedule with breaks. Make it checkable and actionable.

monthlyMap.name: Monthly knowledge audit
monthlyMap.description: Full knowledge check-in on the 1st at 09:00
monthlyMap.prompt: Run a knowledge-map audit of my past month: 1) map which topics are mastered, partially mastered, or untouched; 2) flag material I haven't reviewed in a long time and may have forgotten; 3) point out connection gaps between topics (learned A but never linked it to B); 4) propose a prioritized roadmap to fill the gaps this month.

pomodoroBreak.name: Break reminder
pomodoroBreak.description: Stand up and rest every 2 hours
pomodoroBreak.prompt: You've been studying for 2 hours straight! Take 5 minutes: stretch, grab some water, look away from the screen. A short break now keeps your next session sharp.

midweekDrill.name: Midweek weak-spot drill
midweekDrill.prompt: From my mistakes and flashcard reviews over the past two weeks, identify my 2 shakiest topics. For each, write 3 targeted practice questions (easy to hard) with full solutions and common-pitfall notes. Finish by telling me exactly what to revisit if I get them wrong again.
